content_html:
watched #SahasamSwasagaSagipo : awesome transformation from What the F*** to What a F*** …… n the 4 letter wrd starting with F doesnt stands for Film 😛

first 1 hr was horrible!!! (at least from my perapective as I am not a fan of romace genere) but later on its a BANG!!! seen many reviews stating the climax was week but personally i loved it and thought it was more realistic

undoubtedly NagChaitanya’s best performace till date….heroine was apt and so as other chars

BGM was superb…..Music is ok (again i am not a fan of Rahman’s slow n romantic songs) but lyrics is disgusting (always had this feeling for Rahman’s songs starting with Boy’s)

Vellipomake song ayithe literally audience ki chepinatu undhi…vellipomakandi ikada nunchi cinema superb ga untundhi ani 😛

overall good movie for semi-action movie lovers if they can bear the first 1hr….but i feel concept n story were realistic right from word go
